What I do

I become fluent in your world, then build the bridge to everyone else.

The writing is only the visible part. Before the first draft, I listen, interview, research, challenge assumptions, organize ideas, and find the throughline. The result is communication that sounds authentic, earns trust, and moves people.

About

Curiosity is my operating system.

I have never been intimidated by a subject I did not already understand. Those are usually the projects I enjoy most.

My career has taken me through education, journalism, career coaching, executive ghostwriting, editorial leadership, healthcare, AI, financial services, and legal education. The industries change. The work does not. I learn deeply, ask the questions an audience will ask, and make difficult ideas easier to understand without making them smaller.

I am especially drawn to mission-forward work in healthcare, women’s health, AI, climate, education, and public impact. I believe people make better decisions when they truly understand what is happening, and I want my work to help make that possible.

“How do we make this impossible to misunderstand without making it less true?”
